limitations: Best within the tested finite search, not a global optimum or a solved game.
Direct-screen points use official scoring but do not enforce the HTTP bank.
Only final HTTP match points are used for the final comparison.
Range/caller likelihoods are heuristic, not trained posterior distributions.
Full-match timing is host HTTP; the restricted Docker check uses smoke cases.
Runtime pacing and Python-version floating-point differences can change decisions.
No pooled interval or alternate match-scoring formula is used.
